tasks.subject: Task 1: Relocate + parallelize multi-source fetch into core
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move gatherWindSamples/fetchSmhi/fetchMetNorway into @stp/core, add bounded-concurrency parallelism and a batched Open-Meteo forecast fetch; the CLI re-exports from core.

**Files:** Create packages/core/src/weather/fetchAll.ts; Modify packages/core/src/weather/openMeteo.ts, packages/core/src/index.ts, packages/cli/src/weatherFetch.ts; Test packages/core/tests/fetchAll.test.ts

**Verify:** npx vitest run packages/core/tests/fetchAll.test.ts && npm run typecheck

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/core/src/weather/fetchAll.ts", "packages/core/src/weather/openMeteo.ts", "packages/core/src/index.ts", "packages/cli/src/weatherFetch.ts", "packages/core/tests/fetchAll.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run packages/core/tests/fetchAll.test.ts && npm run typecheck", "acceptanceCriteria": ["core exports gatherWindSamples/fetchSmhi/fetchMetNorway/mapLimit", "Open-Meteo forecast batched to one request", "dead source isolated", "bounded concurrency <=10", "CLI shim re-exports from core"]}
```
